positive_evidence: The Amazon survival loop combines exploration with hunting, fighting, gathering and building, giving the open world several purposeful activities instead of relying on empty traversal; this matches the user's strongest open-world positive pattern around varied activities and usable resource loops.

Resource control, crafting and survival pressure are integrated with active play rather than being standalone negatives, which is compatible with the user's explicit tolerance for resource scarcity and optional progression systems when the underlying activity remains engaging.
